POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER · GEOSPATIAL ENGINEER · AI DEVELOPER

Ahmed MansourPh.D.

Positioning and navigation · Geospatial AI · Civil engineering

Postdoctoral researcher, Department of Land Surveying and Geospatial Science, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

My research focuses on wireless and inertial localization for pedestrian and smartphone navigation, including Wi-Fi/BLE fingerprinting, PDR, multisensor fusion, seamless indoor–outdoor positioning, and mobile crowdsensing. My wider work covers GeoAI, GIS analysis, Android development, and civil engineering.

RESEARCH

Research in positioning, navigation, and spatial analysis

My work centers on pedestrian and smartphone positioning using Wi-Fi, BLE, inertial sensors, GNSS, maps, and mobile crowdsensing. I also develop GIS and GeoAI methods for spatial analysis and engineering applications.

Indoor positioning and multisensor fusion

METHODS AND APPLICATIONS

Research areas and methods

Cross-disciplinary research themes, with detailed methods and experiments available on their dedicated pages.

CORE · POSITIONING & NAVIGATION

Indoor positioning, wireless–inertial localization & sensor fusion

My central research combines Wi-Fi/BLE fingerprinting with inertial and magnetic sensing, pedestrian dead reckoning, heading estimation, GNSS, collaborative positioning, and reliability assessment for smartphone-based indoor and urban navigation.

Wi-Fi fingerprintingBLEPDR/INSGNSSMultisensor fusionLocalization integrity
View positioning and navigation research →
AUTONOMOUS RADIO MAPPING

Mobile crowdsensing & autonomous 3D radio maps

I investigate how ordinary smartphone trajectories and wireless observations can support self-deployable indoor positioning. My work addresses crowdsensed radio-map generation, floor-aware reconstruction, 3D map assembly, fingerprint quality, updating, and long-term reliability.

Crowdsensing3D mappingFloor recognitionRadio-map governance
GEOAI & GIS · EXTENDED APPLICATIONS

GIS, GeoAI & decision support

GIS and GeoAI research addresses spatial suitability, geospatial data quality, evidence-based modelling, scenario revision, and agent-supported analysis. The Agentic GeoSuitability Workbench provides an inspectable prototype of this work.

Spatial MCDAPython GISGeoAI agentsHazard mappingSpatial evaluation
ENGINEERING FOUNDATIONS

Geomatics, surveying & transportation engineering

My engineering experience includes Civil 3D road alignment and cross-section work for the Thumrayt landfill infrastructure in Oman; bridge-load monitoring and GNSS/total-station surveying in Egypt; and teaching road design and software workflows at Cairo University.

Civil 3DHighway designEarthworksSurveyingGNSS geodesy

POSITIONING AND NAVIGATION

Indoor positioning and pedestrian navigation

I investigate wireless and inertial localization for smartphones and pedestrians, including Wi-Fi/BLE positioning, PDR, GNSS integration, and seamless indoor–outdoor navigation. Related work covers positioning reliability, multisensor fusion, mobile crowdsensing, autonomous radio maps, and location-based services.

Explore publications Indoor Positioning Hub

RESEARCH APPROACH

Positioning reliability under changing sensing conditions

My work considers the complete positioning workflow: data collection, radio matching, pedestrian motion estimation, sensor fusion, floor recognition, radio-map construction, and reliability assessment. Evaluation includes accuracy, uncertainty, and deployment constraints.

RESEARCH TOPICS

Research topics and methods

WIRELESS LOCALIZATION

Wi-Fi and BLE indoor positioning

Wi-Fi · BLE · RSS · fingerprint retrieval · reliability

Wi-Fi fingerprinting, passive probe-request localization, scan-level reliability diagnostics, BLE-assisted positioning, radio-map compatibility, candidate geometry, and localization uncertainty.

Read Wi-Fi scan diagnostics Passive Wi-Fi localization pipeline
INERTIAL NAVIGATION

Pedestrian dead reckoning and heading estimation

PDR · INS · IMU · step estimation · heading · motion

Step-based motion estimation and inertial integration using smartphone IMU measurements; heading drift, magnetic interference, carrying-mode variation, and opportunistic correction with reliable environmental observations.

Adaptive Wi-Fi/magnetic heading calibration Smartphone carrying-mode heading corrections
CONTINUOUS POSITIONING

Seamless indoor–outdoor pedestrian positioning

GNSS/PDR · indoor–outdoor detection · source switching

Preserving localization continuity when pedestrians move from GNSS-rich outdoor environments through urban canyons, entrances and transition spaces to multi-floor buildings. Source availability and reliability change along the route.

SUNS: indoor–outdoor navigation GNSS positioning aided by PDR
MOBILE POSITIONING

Smartphone-based navigation and contextual sensing

Android · Java/Kotlin · smartphone IMU · barometer

Using ordinary phones to collect synchronized radio, inertial, magnetic, barometer and environmental context measurements, and to implement and evaluate pedestrian positioning methods under natural phone-use conditions.

Drift control under smartphone poses View Android Wi-Fi diagnostics
RELIABLE MULTISENSOR SYSTEMS

Multisensor fusion, integrity and collaborative positioning

Wi-Fi/BLE · GNSS · PDR · maps · sensor reliability

Combining wireless signals, inertial motion, GNSS, maps and cooperative observations while accounting for drift, uncertainty, signal degradation and conflicting measurements. Positioning quality is treated as an operational property, not only an average accuracy number.

BLE-enhanced GNSS/PDR fusion Map-matched pedestrian positioning
SCALABLE INDOOR POSITIONING

Mobile crowdsensing and autonomous 3D radio maps

Crowdsensing · radio maps · floor recognition · 3D

Reducing manual radio surveying by using pedestrian movement and smartphone observations to acquire, align and maintain indoor fingerprints. The research addresses floor recognition, trajectory reconstruction, uncertainty, map updates and long-term deployment.

Radio-map lifecycle review Everywhere: ubiquitous localization
APPLICATIONS & LOCATION SERVICES

Location-based services and indoor spatial context

Indoor navigation · floors/zones · LBS · deployment

Translating positioning estimates into usable floor, room, corridor and zone context for wayfinding, mobile location-aware services, facility operations, pedestrian assistance and infrastructure monitoring. Application needs guide accuracy, reliability, latency and deployment trade-offs.

Crowd-powered IPS review Browse research and applications

Selected work7 entries

Wireless positioning / Diagnostics

Wi-Fi scan-level reliability assessment

Wi-Fi scan-level diagnostics evaluated on 13,629 queries across 10 building units and eight estimators; implementation includes Python analysis and an Android inspection interface.
Open public repository
Research question

Can a single Wi-Fi scan provide enough evidence to flag a potentially unreliable position estimate?

My contribution

Designed an estimator-independent diagnostic layer covering RSS observation structure, radio-map compatibility, local spatial support and candidate geometry. Developed Python evaluation workflows and an Android scan-inspection interface.

Evidence and limitations

Reported evaluation uses 13,629 held-out queries across 10 building units and eight positioning estimators. Diagnostic support scores are not calibrated probabilities of correctness.

Published evaluation and public implementation.
Published ESWA article ↗Reproducible source and measured examples ↗
RESEARCH VISUALIZATION / SCHEMATIC

Autonomous mapping / Research

Reliability-governed 3D radio mapping

First-author review and deployment-oriented framework for crowdsensed 3D radio-map creation, updating, uncertainty assessment, and validation.
Read related review
Research question

How can crowd-powered radio maps be created and maintained beyond a one-time calibration survey?

My contribution

Led a first-author synthesis of 3D radio-map creation, quality control, spatial consistency, uncertainty assessment, updating, and validation. Connected these stages in a deployment-oriented lifecycle framework.

Evidence and limitations

Published methodological review and framework. Implementation material remains under development; the page does not claim a completed multi-building production deployment.

Published review and research framework.
Information Fusion review ↗Related Everywhere implementation ↗
RESEARCH VISUALIZATION / SCHEMATIC

GNSS / PDR / Navigation

Seamless indoor–outdoor navigation

Pedestrian navigation methods combining GNSS, Wi-Fi, inertial measurements, and indoor–outdoor context recognition.
Read SUNS research
Research question

How can a pedestrian trajectory remain continuous as satellite, wireless and inertial source quality changes between outdoor and indoor spaces?

My contribution

Developed indoor–outdoor awareness and multi-source navigation research with GNSS, Wi-Fi, inertial motion, magnetic and BLE measurements; analyzed source transitions and heading correction.

Evidence and limitations

Supported by the SUNS paper and coauthored GNSS/PDR integration studies; published methods are linked rather than implying a universal commercially deployed navigation system.

Peer-reviewed methods and field-oriented research.
SUNS article ↗IEEE GNSS/PDR study ↗

GeoAI / GIS / AI Agents

Agentic GeoSuitability Workbench

Explore prototype
Research question

Can GIS suitability workflows incorporate AI assistance without losing inspectability and analyst control?

My contribution

Developed the Agentic GeoSuitability Workbench to support geospatial-factor evaluation, spatial processing, scenario revisions, and evidence-linked analysis for suitability applications.

Evidence and limitations

Public prototype available for inspection. No benchmark accuracy or operational deployment claim is made here; users can examine the functionality directly.

Public research prototype; accompanying research is in editorial review.

Seamless 3D indoor positioning for spatially aware AI agents

AI-Empowered, Data-Driven, and Mobile Crowdsensing-Based Seamless 3D Indoor Positioning for Contextually and Spatially Aware AI Agents.

The collaborative programme addresses crowdsensed radio-map generation, multisensor positioning, spatial context, and the reliability of location information for downstream AI applications.

Mobile crowdsensing · Wireless and inertial positioning · 3D radio maps · Sensor fusion
